messages.content: You identify patterns in complete email texts. Respond with valid JSON.

Please write a BRIEF 15-20 word executive summary of the theme "Government and Legal Affairs" as it appears in the following examples.
['Strong preference for lawyers but open to everyone.', 'This email is to all the people that have been scammed in any part of the world, the UNITED NATIONS have agreed to compensate them with the sum of US$...', 'THIS SUM OF $30 MILLION (THIRTY MILLION US DOLLARS) I Would LIKE TO TRANSFER TO YOUR ACCOUNT NOW, WHAT I WANT YOU TO DO IS TO PROVIDED ME YOUR FULL NAME, ADDRESS AND YOUR PRIVATE TELEPHONE NUMBER.', 'In order to process your refund you will need to complete the application form.', 'I am Barrister Chris Woke, a solicitor at law.', 'I am Benjamin Salado a project manager with the Niger Delta Development Commission(NDDC).', 'One tells action put element TRE days la violation Du droid local, national, ET/of international.', 'This is to bring to your notice that I am delegated from the United Nations to Union Bank Of Nigeria to pay 100 Nigerian scam victims $5Million USD each, you are listed and approved for this payment as one of the scammed victims, get back to me as soon as possible with a scan...', 'All the legal documents for the deposit are with my mother which my father gave to her for safe keeping.']

DO NOT write the summary as a third party using terms like "the text examples" or "they discuss", but write the summary from the perspective of the text authors making the points directly.
Please respond ONLY with a valid JSON in the following format:
{
    "summary": "<SUMMARY>"
}
